PerkinElmer Frontier FT-IR, NIR and FIR Spectroscopy
Product catalog summary
Overview: The PerkinElmer Frontier series offers advanced FT-IR, NIR, and FIR spectrometers designed for high performance in demanding applications. These instruments are flexible, allowing for expansion and adaptation to evolving research needs.
Key Features:
Performance and Flexibility: Automated range switching and exceptional signal-to-noise ratios ensure high sensitivity and photometric performance.
Applications: Suitable for chemicals, materials, pharmaceuticals, and academic research, supporting extensive IR analysis with customizable setups.
Advanced Technology: Includes a patented atmospheric compensation algorithm, automatic beam geometry control, and precision-engineered sampling accessories.
Sampling Systems:
Versatility: Accommodates a wide range of smart and third-party modular sample accessories, enhancing uptime and flexibility.
Specialized Applications: Options for polarized UATR, cryogenic measurements, and integrating sphere measurements.
System Configurations:
Dual-Range Instruments: Dual-range performance facilitates method development and materials testing on a single platform.
Expandable Options: Fully upgradeable optical system, including multi-range, microscopy, and imaging systems.
Reliability and Maintenance:
Design: Fixed mirror-pair interferometer design ensures stability and longevity, with electronically stabilized source for increased measurement stability.
Ease of Use: Automated features and user-replaceable components simplify operation and maintenance.
Conclusion: The PerkinElmer Frontier series provides a comprehensive solution for IR spectroscopy, offering unmatched flexibility, performance, and reliability for a wide range of scientific and industrial applications.
Microscopy and Imaging Systems Overview: Highlights advanced features, software capabilities, and support services, emphasizing adaptability, precision, and ease of use for various applications.
Key Features:
Dual-source Mechanism: Fast switching between IR and NIR.
Variable J-stop: Limits beam divergence for optimal measurements.
Absolute Virtual Instrument (AVI): Ensures accurate calibration and precise data transfer.
Atmospheric Vapor Compensation (AVC): Compensates for CO2 and H2O absorptions in real-time.
Patented Dynascan™ Interferometer: Offers stability without dynamic alignment correction.
Output Focusing Optics: Supports simultaneous installation of two sampling accessories.
Temperature-stabilized DTGS Detectors: Ensures reproducibility regardless of ambient temperature.
Sigma-Delta Conversion: Improves dynamic range and reduces spectral artifacts.
Spectrum Software Suite:
Spectrum 10™ Software: Provides full-featured instrument control and data management.
AssureID™ Interface: Offers workflow acquisition and analysis with 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
Customizable Workbench: Allows users to tailor operator functions and software appearance.
Spotlight Imaging Systems: Utilizes the same interferometer technology for high-performance FT-IR microscopy and imaging, supporting transmission and reflection micro-sampling.
Frontier Optica FT-IR: Designed for optical filter, glass, and semiconductor measurements, offering improved ordinate accuracy and reproducibility.
Support Services: Extensive support through a global network of certified technicians, offering training, upgrades, and maintenance services.
Historical Achievements: Outlines milestones in advancing IR technology, from the first IR spectrometer in 1944 to the latest innovations in FT-IR systems.
Conclusion: Designed to meet demanding applications with precision and efficiency, supported by comprehensive services and a commitment to customer success.
